name: First Shift
tagline: Open the lot and keep capacity moving.
brief: Park arriving cars and release finished stays through the exit checkpoint.
context: Every arrival is a standard car, but cars finish their stays at different times.
narrative:
Cars join the entrance queue over time. Your controller sees the vehicle at the front and chooses a parking action.

When a stay ends, the vehicle requests an exit but still occupies its space until the controller releases it. Capacity becomes reusable only after the exit process completes.
objective: Serve every arriving car without an allocation violation.
learningObjective: Control both sides of a facility: allocate arrivals and explicitly release completed resources.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starting brain has no rules. Add one rule for ready exits and one for waiting arrivals.

The decision flow should consider exit work before new parking work so completed vehicles can free capacity for the next arrival.
hints: Watch the entrance queue: its first car is the only vehicle the controller allocates this tick.
A standard car only needs the standard allocation action.
Use hasExitRequest → release-vehicle and hasWaitingVehicle → park-standard. Exit first keeps capacity turning over.

steps.label: Authorize a car through the exit checkpoint

functions.description: Assign the head vehicle to a standard space.
Authorize the oldest exit request and free its space.

objectives.label: Average entry and exit wait no more than one tick
